recognize_zh: 低倍骨切片：右側為骨小樑，左側為緻密平行排列的膠原纖維組織，中間骨髓腔被細胞密集的浸潤取代、看不到正常脂肪與造血組織；低倍下只能看出骨髓被取代，淋巴瘤的細胞型態需搭配高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Bone trabeculae (right) with an intertrabecular space densely filled by a cellular infiltrate
Loss of normal fat and trilineage hematopoiesis within the involved marrow space
Discohesive medium to large cells in the upper marrow compartment at this magnification
Dense, parallel-oriented fibrocollagenous tissue on the left (periosteum/soft tissue)
Spindled, crushed dark cells at the lower interface; fine cytologic detail not assessable at low power
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone biopsy shows bony trabeculae with an intertrabecular marrow space that is replaced by a dense cellular infiltrate, with loss of normal fat and hematopoietic elements. Dense parallel fibrocollagenous tissue is present at the left, and crushed spindled cells are seen at the lower interface. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, so the cell type cannot be determined from this field alone. In the clinical context, findings are compatible with marrow and bone involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, which requires high-power morphology and immunohistochemistry for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Forms cohesive nests often with desmoplastic stroma and is keratin-positive, CD45-negative.
Sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, CD138 positivity and monotypic cytoplasmic light chains.
Same DLBCL morphology but confined to bone without nodal or systemic disease on staging.
Infiltrate is mixed neutrophils, plasma cells and lymphocytes with necrotic bone rather than monotonous atypical cells.
